items.ti: 선거 직후 주식 시장이 3조 달러의 가치를 잃었다는 사실을 아는 사람이 있습니까? 즉, 전 세계 투자자들은 선거일에 무슨 일이 일어났는지 보는 것을 싫어했습니다. 하지만 두려워하지 마세요. 시장은 그 이후로 상승했고 미국은 곧 그 어느 때보다 더 위대해질 것입니다! 도널드 J. 트럼프 대통령
items.ti_en: Has anyone noticed that immediately after the Election the Stock Market lost 3 Trillion Dollars in Value? In other words, Investors throughout the World hated seeing what took place on Election Day. But have no fear, the Market has since gone up, and America will soon be GREATER THAN EVER BEFORE! President DONALD J. TRUMP

items.ti: Trash Island는 현재 세계 최악의 골프 코스이지만, 내무부는 세계 최고의 골프 ​​코스로 만들 예정입니다. 불행하게도 Ana Reyes 판사는 우리가 매우 위험한 코스를 빠르고 저렴하게 수정하는 것을 원하지 않습니다. 페어웨이는 서로 너무 가깝습니다. 쓰레기 섬의 복도를 걸어가면 달리는 포토맥 소리는 들리지 않고, 사람들이 “FORE!”라고 외치는 소리만 들린다. 어쨌든 우리는 진전을 이루고 있으며, 곧 이 아름다운 프로젝트를 통해 워싱턴 D.C.의 존엄성, 아름다움, 중요성이 크게 향상될 것이라는 점에 판사께서 동의하시기를 바랍니다. 수년간의 웃음과 경멸 끝에 Trash Island는 판사가 보고 큰 자부심을 가질 수 있는 매우 특별한 것으로 진화할 것입니다! 전 세계에서 bei로 호평을 받을 것입니다.
items.ti_en: Trash Island is currently the Worst Golf Course anywhere in the World, but the Department of the Interior is going to make it into the Best Golf Course anywhere in the World. Unfortunately, Judge Ana Reyes doesn’t want us to quickly and inexpensively fix up the Course which is, also, very dangerous — The Fairways are far too close together. When you walk down the corridors of Trash Island, you don’t hear the sound of the running Potomac, all you hear is the sound of people screaming, “FORE!” In any event, we’re making progress, and hopefully the Judge will agree that the Dignity, Beauty, and Importance of Washington, D.C., will be greatly enhanced by this soon to be beautiful Project. Trash Island, after years of laughter and scorn, will evolve into something very special, something which the Judge will be able to take great pride in seeing! All over the World it will be acclaimed as being the Best Golf Course anywhere, attracting the U.S. Open, the PGA Championship, the Ryder Cup, and the Presidents Cup, with all of the Economic Development that will bring. Very importantly, also, is that anyone living in the D.C. area will be given a 50% discount on any and all Rates charged. The Department of the Interior has done a magnificent job of cleaning, fixing, renovating, and rebuilding 83 Fountains, Monuments, and Statues throughout our beautiful Capital. Even the Reflecting Pool, which hasn’t worked properly since its building in 1922, is open, beautiful, and working as it was always expected to do. Perhaps most importantly, Crime in Washington, D.C., is down 91%, A RECORD, and the People are happy and safe again! The Department of the Interior’s Golf Project will greatly enhance everything else that has already taken place in the last two year period. Everyone is proud and grateful again! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP
